capabilities: Add existing Markdown notes to file-backed timelines stored as .timeline files
Read dates from note properties or a leading 📅 line at minute-to-century precision, including BCE
Collapse cards to title, date, and tags or expand them to render native Markdown
Zoom, pan, fit, and jump along the time axis, with horizontal or vertical orientation
Persist timeline membership, layout, and date settings per file and across tabs
extras: The 0.4.1 interface is Russian; English documentation includes the Russian control labels. Community-directory installation is pending Obsidian staff review, and the README warns to back up and sync .timeline files with their notes, using one active writer per timeline. Support via Boosty.
motivation: The author built it because projects, research journals, and collections of ideas often make more sense in chronological order.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in chronological view, so users cannot see when their existing notes' milestones, events, or log entries happened in order.
summary: Timeline view that arranges existing vault notes as expandable Markdown cards on a horizontal or vertical time axis, with persisted layouts in .timeline files.
